item.title: হাজারীবাগে এ জে আর কুরিয়ারের গাড়িতে টানা তিন সপ্তাহ ধরে হামলা
item.description: রাজধানীর হাজারীবাগে অবস্থিত এ জে আর পার্সেল অ্যান্ড কুরিয়ার সার্ভিসেস লিমিটেডের পরিবহনে গত তিন সপ্তাহ ধরে হামলা চালানো হচ্ছে। গ্রাহকের পণ্য সারা দেশে বিতরণের জন্য এই গুদাম থেকে গাড়িগুলো ছাড়ার পরই হামলার শিকার হচ্ছে।

item.title: হাসিনাকে ফেরাতে সামরিক বিমান চেয়ে দিল্লির খবর নিয়ে মুখ খুললেন না জয়সোয়াল
item.description: ক্ষমতাচ্যুত প্রধানমন্ত্রী শেখ হাসিনাকে ফিরিয়ে নিতে নয়াদিল্লি সামরিক বিমান পাঠাতে চায় কি না, গণমাধ্যমের এমন প্রশ্নের উত্তর দেওয়া থেকে বিরত থেকেছেন ভারতের পররাষ্ট্র মন্ত্রণালয়ের মুখপাত্র রণধীর জয়সোয়াল।

item.title: ১৯৭৩ সালে যে কারণে মাত্র ১৭ সেকেন্ডেই শেষ হয়েছিল ফুটবল ম্যাচটি
item.description: ১৯৭৩ সালের ২১ নভেম্বর চিলির সান্তিয়াগোতে অনুষ্ঠিত একটি বিশ্বকাপ বাছাইপর্বের ম্যাচ মাত্র ১৭ সেকেন্ডেই শেষ হয়েছিল। ফুটবল ইতিহাসে এই অস্বাভাবিক ঘটনাটি 'দ্য ঘোস্ট ম্যাচ' বা 'ভুতুড়ে ম্যাচ' হিসেবে পরিচিত।

item.title: Proposed penalties for animal harassment in digital content creation
item.description: New legal measures are being proposed to introduce jail time and financial penalties for harassing animals while producing online content. This initiative aims to protect wildlife and pets from distress caused by digital creators.ด์

item.title: এনভিডিয়ার সাবেক সিইও জেনসেন হুয়াংকে ঘিরে চীন ও যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের উদ্বেগ
item.description: শীর্ষ চিপ নির্মাতা প্রতিষ্ঠান এনভিডিয়ার পদত্যাগী প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা জেনসেন হুয়াংয়ের ব্যক্তিগত জীবন নিয়ে সৃষ্ট পরিস্থিতিতে চীন ও যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের মধ্যে নতুন করে উদ্বেগ সৃষ্টি হয়েছে। তাঁকে কেন্দ্র করে গুপ্তচরবৃত্তির অভিযোগও সামনে আসছে।

item.title: Microsoft Outlook service gradually recovers after prolonged global outage
item.description: Global access for Microsoft Outlook and 365 is slowly returning following a nearly two-day disruption affecting numerous users worldwide. Although certain applications and tools continue to experience performance issues, recovery is underway.ด์

item.title: বাঁশখালীতে বাবার ঝুলন্ত মরদেহ ও দুই যমজ কন্যার লাশ উদ্ধার
item.description: চট্টগ্রামের বাঁশখালীতে একটি ঘর থেকে এক ব্যক্তির ঝুলন্ত মরদেহ এবং তাঁর পাঁচ মাস বয়সী যমজ দুই মেয়ের লাশ উদ্ধার করেছে পুলিশ। শুক্রবার সন্ধ্যায় উপজেলার পুঁইছড়ি ইউনিয়ন থেকে এই মরদেহগুলো উদ্ধার করা হয়।

item.title: নোয়াখালীতে শ্রমিক দল নেতাকে হত্যার অভিযোগে সাবেক স্ত্রীসহ তিনজন গ্রেপ্তার
item.description: নোয়াখালীর চাটখিলে এক শ্রমিক দল নেতাকে পূর্বপরিকল্পিতভাবে ডেকে নিয়ে হত্যার পর মাটিচাপা দেওয়ার ঘটনায় তাঁর সাবেক স্ত্রীসহ তিনজনকে গ্রেপ্তার করা হয়েছে। আইনশৃঙ্খলা রক্ষাকারী বাহিনী বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করেছে।ด์

item.title: Assam Road Collision Claims 24 Lives
item.description: A collision between a bus and a truck in India's Assam state left a minimum of 24 individuals dead. Authorities noted that minors and the bus operator are among the victims, and fatalities may increase.

item.title: EU Foreign Chief Warns Against Russian Negotiation Traps
item.description: European Union foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas cautioned against falling into Russian traps regarding negotiations on Ukraine. She specifically advised against accepting Moscow's suggested ordering of events for discussions.

item.title: Metropolitan Police Probe David Walliams Over Sexual Offenses
item.description: London's Metropolitan Police are examining David Walliams concerning accusations of serious sexual misconduct. Law enforcement clarified that these claims are distinct from recent reports published by ITN and The Guardian.

item.title: Rabada Pleased With Supporter Support Following Australia Victory
item.description: Kagiso Rabada expressed happiness regarding spectator engagement after securing a series triumph against Australia. As a series against Bangladesh starts Sunday, he anticipates entertaining matches to display sport vitality in South Africa.

item.title: OpenAI Introduces ChatGPT Wallet for Automated Purchases
item.description: OpenAI has launched a ChatGPT Wallet feature that enables artificial intelligence agents to purchase items and complete transactions for individuals. This capability begins with a restricted release directed at Pro subscribers in the United States.

item.title: Kerala High Court Summons KSEB Engineer Over Kochi Traffic Delay
item.description: The Kerala High Court issued a summons to a KSEB engineer due to postponed efforts to ease traffic congestion in Pachalam, Kochi. Although funds were approved, the electricity board's submission to railway officials contained errors needing revision.

item.title: Navi Mumbai Resident Arrested in Ottapalam Over Suspected Terror Ties
item.description: Law enforcement detained Gurumoorthy, a resident of Navi Mumbai, in Ottapalam on suspicion of connections to terrorism. The suspect faces charges under the Unlawful Activities Prevention Act.

item.title: Literary Event Opens in Madurai Led by Minister
item.description: A minister formally opened a book exhibition located in Madurai.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid scandal
item.description: Following a relationship scandal, Jensen Huang has stepped down from Nvidia. This departure may impact national security amid the ongoing artificial intelligence technology race between the United States and China.

item.title: Criticism follows meat sales suspension for PM visit
item.description: A temporary halt on meat sales prior to the prime minister's arrival has sparked criticism. Law enforcement authorities attributed the restriction to helicopter safety protocols.

item.title: Court orders medical care for injured prison inmates
item.description: Madras High Court judges mandated medical care for recaptured inmates after examinations verified injuries from alleged beatings by Theni prison guards.

item.title: Coimbatore electricity board applies September rates to units
item.description: A total of 3,454 electricity connections located in Coimbatore will be charged according to the tariff rates established in the month of September.

item.title: Mahadayi basin initiative removed from federal portal
item.description: The central government has taken the Mahadayi basin construction plans off the digital queue of pending proposals. According to Goa officials, the union administration cancelled project approval.

item.title: Students receive greeting cards and baked goods
item.description: Children attending school were presented with greeting cards alongside cakes.

item.title: Qatar and Turkey formalize bilateral defense pact
item.description: An official mutual defense pact has been concluded between Turkey and Qatar. This is an unfolding news report.

item.title: Ambati Rayudu works to reform cricket in Hyderabad
item.description: Six months into his pledge to reform local cricket culture, former Indian cricketer Ambati Rayudu has been active at early morning practices and material suppliers. He has also lost between five and seven kilograms in the process.

item.title: High Court Chief Justice opens new court complex and arbitration hub
item.description: The head of the Madras High Court officially opened a fresh judicial complex alongside a dedicated mediation and arbitration facility.

item.title: Actor in Ankita Bhandari homicide case faces lie detector and truth serum exams
item.description: A judicial directive mandates polygraph and narco-analysis evaluations for an entertainer linked to the Ankita Bhandari homicide investigation following claims about an influential politician's complicity.

item.title: Educators in Malappuram organize football tournament to combat substance abuse
item.description: The Tirurangadi Teachers Squad is hosting a football competition designed to educate youth about the dangers of narcotics while promoting athletic lifestyles.

item.title: The Verge publishes curated 2026 father's day present suggestions
item.description: A new selection of unique gift ideas has been compiled for fathers, moving beyond traditional items like neckties and shaving gear to offer more memorable options.

item.title: Paprika recipe application launches major version four update with subscription
item.description: The digital cookbook and pantry management platform Paprika has released version four after a decade, introducing expanded features alongside a new payment model.

item.title: Educator arrested under the provisions of the POCSO legislation
item.description: Authorities have taken an instructor into custody following allegations invoking the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

item.title: Annual Koti Deepotsavam spiritual festival commences and runs through November 30
item.description: The Koti Deepotsavam celebrations have officially started and are scheduled to continue until the end of November.

item.title: Prime Minister highlights historical educational and scientific legacy of Mysuru Wadiyars
item.description: Prime Minister Modi acknowledged the educational and scientific advancements fostered by the royal Wadiyar dynasty of Mysuru.

item.title: Jharkhand Legislator Accused of Minor's Rape
item.description: An FIR has been filed against Congress legislator Bhushan Bara over accusations of assaulting a 14-year-old girl. The politician has denied any wrongdoing, claiming the case is a political conspiracy orchestrated by adversaries and intermediaries.

item.title: Port Office Anomalies Uncovered by Vigilance
item.description: Authorities responsible for vigilance checks have identified procedural inconsistencies within the Kasaragod port office. The findings highlight operational shortcomings requiring administrative review.

item.title: Madurai Observes Children's Day Events
item.description: A government minister led the official Children's Day commemorative events held in Madurai. The gathering marked the occasion with various official activities.

item.title: Rotary Club Initiative Treats 48 Youths
item.description: The Rotary Club of Palghat East organized an outing for 48 disadvantaged youths to visit the Fantasy Park amusement venue. The 'Happy Days' program aimed to provide recreational enjoyment to the participants.

item.title: Kochi Hosts Global Arachnology Congress
item.description: The International Congress of Arachnology began in Kochi on November 15 and runs through November 21. The schedule includes 170 academic sessions featuring lectures, workshops, and symposia.

item.title: Demonstration Follows Fatal Hospital Incident
item.description: Family members and locals staged a demonstration at a medical facility in K.R. Nagar following a female patient's death. Protesters gathered to demand accountability regarding the circumstances of the passing.

item.title: বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় শিক্ষার্থীর সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায় মৃত্যু
item.description: অতীশ দীপঙ্কর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের প্রথম বর্ষের ছাত্র মোবারক হোসেন পড়াশোনার পাশাপাশি একটি আবাসন প্রতিষ্ঠানে খণ্ডকালীন চাকরি করতেন। কর্মস্থল থেকে ভাষানটেক এলাকার বাসায় ফেরার পথে সড়ক দুর্ঘটনায় তার মৃত্যু হয়।

item.title: Jain Monk Warns Congress Regime Over Demands
item.description: Gunadhar Nandi Maharaj has cautioned the state administration regarding unmet demands and threatened to undertake Sallekhana Vrata. He plans to spearhead a demonstration march toward Belagavi's Suvarna Soudha starting December 4.

item.title: European Union aims for role in Ukraine negotiations
item.description: European officials want to participate in Ukraine peace discussions. They fear a US-led initiative could let Washington and Moscow determine the war's outcome alone.

item.title: Father challenges special court directive in Akash Delison case
item.description: The father of the late Akash Delison has petitioned to invalidate a recent ruling by a special tribunal regarding his son's death in police custody.

item.title: Copper values drop near four-month low on rate hike fears
item.description: Copper rates hit a nearly four-month trough due to concerns over potential US interest rate increases and reduced artificial intelligence demand. FIMI projects short-term volatility before long-term demand pushes prices up.

item.title: Assam crash between truck and bus leaves 26 dead
item.description: A collision involving a truck and a minibus in Rongajan near Kaziranga resulted in 26 fatalities and numerous injuries. The passenger vehicle was heading from Bokakhat to Nagaon when the truck struck it.

item.title: BRS protests Green SM cab approval over job security concerns
item.description: The BRS party is objecting to the authorization of Green SM cabs. Officials stated the move endangers the employment security of existing taxi drivers.

item.title: Upcoming UK-EU pact to eliminate £60m in plant trade expenses
item.description: A forthcoming agreement between the UK and the European Union will eliminate £60 million in yearly expenses for the horticulture sector. Minister Angela Eagle noted that removing administrative burdens and border inspections will ease the transport of biological goods.

item.title: Kishoreganj politics heat up over potential case involvement
item.description: Statements from retired Major Mohammad Akhteruzzaman and local BNP figures have heightened political tensions in Kishoreganj. The dispute centers on fears that BNP members might be implicated in a case regarding an assault on Akhteruzzaman's son.

item.title: Central government expected to deny Punjab CM Lahore visit
item.description: New Delhi is reportedly unlikely to approve Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's planned trip to Pakistan. He intended to attend the International Punjabi Conference scheduled in Lahore from November 27 to 29.

item.title: Tom Coyd's Strategy Powered England's Wheelchair Rugby World Cup Victory
item.description: England secured the Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup title following a four-year strategy implemented by head coach Tom Coyd. His tactics included pushing the squad to adopt a fierce, shark-like mentality during matches.

item.title: Retailers Launch Early Technology Discounts Ahead of Black Friday
item.description: Shops are rolling out early gadget discounts well ahead of the official November 27 Black Friday shopping event. These initial price cuts arrive amidst broader economic price increases.

item.title: Washington Commanders Defeat New York Giants 24-21 via Late Touchdown
item.description: Stefon Diggs secured a decisive late touchdown, propelling the Washington Commanders to a 24-21 victory over the New York Giants.

item.title: NITI Aayog Highlights India's Reliance on Overseas Food Imports
item.description: Government think tank NITI Aayog has raised concerns regarding the country's heavy dependence on imported food commodities, specifically pointing to Canadian masoor and Australian chana.

item.title: Enforcement Directorate Arrests Mahadev Betting App Co-Promoter
item.description: Financial investigators arrested Saurabh Chandrakar, co-promoter of the Mahadev betting platform, in connection with a money laundering probe. Authorities obtained a seven-day custody order to interrogate him.

item.title: Delivery Worker and Associates Attack Elderly Couple and Man
item.description: Investigators are examining CCTV footage and reviewing the history of a delivery employee following an assault on an elderly couple and another man stemming from a minor argument.

item.title: New Delhi Open to Bilateral Talks With Dhaka Regardless of Hasina Dispute
item.description: The Ministry of External Affairs stated that India remains prepared to address all bilateral matters with Bangladesh. Officials clarified that the upcoming consular talks were postponed rather than canceled due to passport issues.

item.title: Global Microsoft Tech Failure Persists Past 18 Hours
item.description: A widespread technical disruption affecting millions globally continued past the 18-hour mark, though Microsoft noted gradual recoveries in service availability.

item.title: Russia warns Canada and Germany over international hockey ban
item.description: Russia plans legal action against tournament organizers in Canada and Germany following its continued exclusion from global ice hockey contests. This comes two weeks after the CAS instructed the sport's governing body to restore Russian participation.

item.title: Mossad leader discusses Iran strategy in Washington amid US friction
item.description: The head of Israel's Mossad intelligence agency traveled to Washington for discussions regarding Iran. Reports indicate the meetings occur while Donald Trump pushes back against Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: বাংলাদেশ নারী দলের ৯ উইকেটের জয়, ছিলে না অধিনায়ক
item.description: পাকিস্তানের বিপক্ষে প্রথম ম্যাচে ডান হাতের আঙুলে ইনজুরি পাওয়ায় নিয়মিত অধিনায়ক নাহিদা আক্তারকে ছাড়াই মাঠে নামে বাংলাদেশ। তবে এই অনুপস্থিতি ছাপিয়ে দলটি ৯ উইকেটের বড় ব্যবধানে জয় তুলে নেয়।

item.title: Pochettino weeps when discussing his exit from USA for Manchester United
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino became emotional while discussing his departure from the United States national team. He described his choice to accept the managerial position at Manchester United as very difficult.
